user.title: Connect to Rooster Wake
user.description: Create an API key on the Rooster Wake dashboard (Account, then API keys) with the Wake and Read permissions — add the Power permission too if you want sleep, restart and shutdown buttons. API keys are available on the Plus and Pro plans. Self-hosters: point the instance URL at your own deployment.

machines.title: Choose machines
machines.description: These are the machines saved on your Rooster Wake account. Pick the ones to show in Home Assistant. Machines are added and edited on the Rooster Wake dashboard — a machine added there later appears here under Configure.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to Rooster Wake
reauth_confirm.description: The stored API key was refused — it may have been revoked or expired. Paste a fresh key from the Rooster Wake dashboard.

error.invalid_auth: That API key was refused. Keys are created on the Rooster Wake dashboard and are available on the Plus and Pro plans — the free plan has none.
error.missing_scope: The key works but lacks the Read permission. Create a key with both Wake and Read permissions.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Rooster Wake service at that address.
error.invalid_url: The instance URL must start with http:// or https://.

abort.already_configured: This API key is already configured.
abort.no_machines: This account has no saved machines yet. Add your machines on the Rooster Wake dashboard first, then set this integration up.

machines.title: Choose machines
machines.description: The account's saved machines, as they are right now. Machines are added and edited on the Rooster Wake dashboard.

data.confirm_wakes: Ask the service to confirm wakes (probe whether the machine actually came up)

abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Rooster Wake service to list machines. Try again in a moment.
